infrastructure_findings: The execution command referenced a nonexistent .env in the M0.6 worktree, so ClickHouse used default empty credentials and returned HTTP 401.
The authoritative existing environment file remains at /Users/ajaneeigharo/Projects/agentic-analytics-lab/.env; no credential was changed.
M07_LOWEST_RATE failed inside the local Ollama request with HTTP 500 and produced no raw model response.
model_findings: Both SQL-bearing responses referenced agentic_analytics.delivery_work_items and passed the unchanged read-only validator.
Both SQL-bearing responses treated blocked_pct as an existing source column instead of computing 100 * SUM(blocked) / COUNT(*).
The repository schema has blocked but no blocked_pct column, so neither preserved SQL statement can return the preregistered result.
